_comment: Copy to attio.json (gitignored). Holds the Attio API token + field mapping used to WRITE follow-up activity back to the CRM. Writes are conservative by design: log a note + ensure a follow-up task; stage changes require approval; nothing is ever deleted. See ATTIO_SETUP.md.

techtower._objects_note: Object slugs the sweep will try to match a contact/company against, in priority order. Confirm these exist via GET /v2/objects.
techtower._match_note: Which attribute to match the email sender / company on, per object.

writeBack._optional_attrs: If these custom attributes exist on the object, the sweep will set them. Leave blank to skip. Use the attribute slug from GET /v2/objects/{object}/attributes.
writeBack._stage_note: Auto-advancing a deal stage is OFF by default and ALWAYS requires explicit approval in the run. Never set this to auto-close/auto-win.

_dealStageSync_note: Used by deal-stage-sync.md (the daily STAGE automation) — separate from the conservative write-back above. That sweep never moves stages; THIS one does, by design. Gated by enabled:false until you opt in.
